vetSays.line: 🛡️ Barbara, Fritz, Naomi and Hunter met them at the door — 4 put down. Barbara, Fritz, Naomi, Hunter are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Glasswing Darter (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
Wei strikes the Pack-leader Glasswing Darter.
The Pack-leader Glasswing Darter shifts, seeking a clear lane.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Glasswing Darter!
🛡️ Fiona, Barbara, Fritz, Hunter and Owen met them at the door — 5 put down. Fiona, Barbara, Fritz, Hunter, Owen are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Farid just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Barbara, Fritz, Naomi, Hunter and Farid met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 barely walked away. Barbara, Fritz, Naomi, Hunter, Farid are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Big Big!

regDeaths.name: a dog-shaped silence at the treeline
